T: Who you gonna call. The diner.
D: A single mum and her kids move into her late father's Oklahoma farmhouse and find what he left behind.
P: Serve the snacks when the tiny marshmallow men get loose in the supermarket.
S: the tiny marshmallow men who run riot in the store
Big marshmallows stacked in twos on skewers, eyes and smile piped in melted dark chocolate, half of them toasted with a blowtorch.
Okra cut into rounds, tossed in cornmeal and fried crisp, with hot sauce. Slice 500g okra into 1cm rounds, toss in 150ml buttermilk, then in 150g cornmeal mixed with 50g flour, salt and pepper.
the dusty old farmhouse full of secrets
Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk, egg and melted butter mixed briefly, baked in a hot buttered cast iron pan at 220C for 20 minutes. Honey butter.
M: the carhop diner with the skating waiters
Chuck patties smashed on a smoking griddle, American cheese, pickles, onion and burger sauce on soft buns, crinkle-cut fries, delivered on a tray.
dinner in the small Oklahoma town
Minute steaks pounded thin, dredged in seasoned flour, buttermilk and flour again, fried until crisp, covered in black pepper cream gravy. Mash and green beans.
W: a giant marshmallow man, in pie form
Biscuit crumb base, dark chocolate ganache filling, topped with a tall marshmallow meringue torched until blistered.
K: the drinks at the roller diner
Vanilla ice cream blended thick with cold milk and a little vanilla, whipped cream and a cherry, served in tall glasses.

s.note: the tiny marshmallow men who run riot in the store
s.how: Stack 2 big marshmallows on each of 12 bamboo skewers. Pipe eyes and a smile on each with 50g melted dark chocolate. Toast half of them with a blowtorch for the full effect.
Slice 500g okra into 1cm rounds, toss in 150ml buttermilk, then in 150g cornmeal mixed with 50g flour, salt and pepper. Fry at 180C for 3 minutes until crisp and serve with hot sauce.

m.note: the carhop diner with the skating waiters
m.how: Smash 8 thin patties from 800g chuck mince on a smoking griddle and add American cheese. Stack two per soft bun with pickles, onion and burger sauce of mayo and relish. Fry 1kg crinkle-cut potatoes twice.

w.note: a giant marshmallow man, in pie form
w.how: Press 250g crushed biscuits with 100g melted butter into a pie tin. Pour in 200g dark chocolate melted with 200ml cream and set. Whisk 3 whites with 150g sugar over hot water, beat stiff, pile tall and torch until blistered.

d.note: the drinks at the roller diner
d.how: For each shake, blend 3 scoops vanilla ice cream with 150ml cold milk and a drop of vanilla until thick. Pour into tall glasses and top with whipped cream and a cherry.
